description:
One cell of a two-by-two: the reference, at the point the ours search found.
Each search's best point is run under both implementations, so the four cells differ in exactly two things and a row of them can be read. The earlier attempt at this could not be read, because the two kernels spent one seed differently -- seven keys against three -- and so began from different parameters and different environment resets. They now begin from the same ones, asserted leaf by leaf at zero last bits, which is what makes a single run per cell worth anything on a task whose seed spread is a thousand points wide.
What the columns answer: whether a point that one implementation found good is good under the other, from the same start. What is left over after that is the frameworks' own difference, and the one candidate still uncontrolled is where normalisation lives -- inside this kernel, around the reference's environment.
name: cell-ours-point-on-upstream
